i.norm: Verifies that changing the id type on a Value produces a distinct Value: the original EMPTY value (whose id type is NONE) is not equal to the derived value that uses MINIMAL_CLASS as its id type. The derived value should also keep the default (false) id visibility.
The two values differ only by id type, so they must not be equal (both directions).
Id visibility is not affected by withIdType and stays at its default of false.
